lines.zh: 我压着身子在岩壁上爬
lines.en: I crawl low along the rock face
On all fours, I shift one step at a time

lines.zh: 我的爪子先落下，再是脚
lines.en: My claws touch down first, then my feet
I move sideways through the shadows

lines.zh: 我的脊背拱起来又塌下
lines.en: My back arches and caves as I go
I brush over the gravel on the ground

lines.zh: 我从一块岩跳到另一块
lines.en: I spring from one rock to the next

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，从不走中间
lines.en: I keep to the wall, never the middle
My steps are lighter than you would think
I leave a gust of hot air behind

lines.zh: 我的腹部擦过灼热的地面
lines.en: My belly grazes the scorched ground

lines.zh: 我一边爬一边换着落爪点
lines.en: I change my footholds as I crawl
I crouch with my limbs tucked under

lines.zh: 我的头低着，眼睛向上看
lines.en: My head is low, my eyes look up
I wait for prey to come close
A claw tip scrapes the ground
My breathing is shallow

lines.zh: 我一动不动地缩在暗处
lines.en: I stay tucked motionless in the dark
I listen to the echo of footsteps
My muscles stay taut
I am calculating my leap
The tip of my tail sways slightly
You are in my shadow
I have waited long for you to turn
You carry the aftertaste of Argent
I am in no hurry to move
You take a step, I gain a block
My knees are bent very low

lines.zh: 你听见的那声呼吸是我
lines.en: That breath you heard was mine
I look up at you from below
You should not have taken this path

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经松开了地
lines.en: My claws have let go of the ground
The blow turned me off course
A spot under my ribs has caved in
I crawl back half a block

lines.zh: 血在下界的岩面上很暗
lines.en: Blood looks dark on Nether rock
I bare my teeth once

lines.zh: 我爬回去用了两倍时间
lines.en: It takes me twice as long to crawl back
I shrink back into the shadow
My claws slipped on the ground
I can still crouch
I stare toward what hurt me
I will not even sniff a dead thing
You hold it up and step back twice
I sniff, then pull back
That thing would slow me down
Take it away, I want something that runs
A low growl rolls from my throat

lines.zh: 你手里那点不够我一口
lines.en: That is not enough for one bite

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面划了一下
lines.en: My claw scored the ground
I am not interested in that
You are still holding it up, how strange
One bump and I am stuck to you
I roll over at once and pull back
We collide into a heap in the dark

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到了我的肋骨
lines.en: Your knee found my ribs
I slide away with your force

lines.zh: 这一下让我失了起跳的姿势
lines.en: That cost me my crouch

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住了你的袖子
lines.en: My claw caught your sleeve
We part and each find footing

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到了汗味
lines.en: I smell sweat on you

lines.zh: 你这副骨头比看上去硬
lines.en: Your bones are harder than they look
We never appear two at once
I am alone on this rock face

lines.zh: 这种事在我的本能里没有
lines.en: That is not in my instincts
You are asking the wrong one
I am only a predator
My kind do not meet
I tilt my head and glance at you
This topic is meaningless
I put my attention back on the rock
I crawl on upward
I pick up a bone in my teeth
This still has some use
I hook it closer with the back of a claw

lines.zh: 地上的东西我都闻一遍
lines.en: I sniff everything on the ground
I tear it open and look
This piece is useless
I fling it behind me
I keep this to sharpen my claws
I bite it once and drop it
It rolled down the rock face
You just moved
I lock onto your ankle
One stride covers this gap
My back has arched up

lines.zh: 我的前爪已经离地半寸
lines.en: My foreclaws are half an inch off the ground
You are alive, and that is enough
My eyes glow in the dark
I have my landing point
The leap takes only one motion

lines.zh: 你听见声音的时候已经晚了
lines.en: You hear it too late
I see it, its back is to me
I slide down the rock face

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一声闷响
lines.en: A low sound sits in my throat
I chose its weakest side
I circle around the flank
You keep looking forward
I flatten myself against the ground
The rock shadow hides me
I change position step by step

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声我都听得见
lines.en: I can hear your every breath
I wait for you to reach the edge
My claws are slowly digging in
One more step into my range
My back is fully arched

lines.zh: 我在它头顶三格的位置
lines.en: I am three blocks above its head
I rotate to follow its angle
I lie flat without stirring

lines.zh: 它的脚步越来越靠近岩壁
lines.en: Its steps come closer to the wall
The sinews of my hind legs are drawn tight
I press my whole body to the stone
I spring from below
My foreclaws land first
This blow comes in from the side
I bite its leg and roll
I drag it to the ground
My hind legs push off once
That knocked it off balance
I bear down, claws tightening

lines.zh: 我退开半步，准备第二下
lines.en: I pull back half a step for the second

lines.zh: 我从上面的岩块跳下去
lines.en: I leap down from the rock above

lines.zh: 我一爪扫在它的小腿上
lines.en: One claw sweeps its calf

lines.zh: 我落地时顺势把它压住
lines.en: I land and use the motion to pin it

lines.zh: 我的牙齿找到了它的肩
lines.en: My teeth find its shoulder
I drag once and let go
This blow is only to bring it down
I slip around its arm from the left

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的阴影里落下来
lines.en: I drop from the rock's shadow
All four limbs land first

lines.zh: 我比你看上去的更贴地
lines.en: I hug the ground more than you would think

lines.zh: 下界的岩壁到处都是我的位置
lines.en: The Nether's walls have a place for me everywhere
I arch my spine into a bridge

lines.zh: 我的爪子在新地面上试了试
lines.en: My claws test the new ground
I did not come here to leave
This patch of shadow is mine

lines.zh: 我抬头看清了你的方向
lines.en: I raise my head and sight your direction

lines.zh: 我从上方的岩台伏下来
lines.en: I lower myself from the ledge above

lines.zh: 我跑得比它快不了多少，但会等
lines.en: I am barely faster than it, but I will wait

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在这片热风里很轻
lines.en: My breathing is faint in this hot wind

lines.zh: 火从我的背上一路烧过去
lines.en: Fire ran along my back
I crashed onto the ledge below
Liquid poured into my windpipe

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来撞在墙上
lines.en: The blast threw me against the wall

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸打穿了我的肩
lines.en: A shot went through my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股术力让我四肢发酸
lines.en: That magic left my limbs aching
I have not caught anything in too long
Lightning ran down my spine
There is nothing left for me to grip
